title: Session length: shorter default and faster turns before touching the rules
problem: Informal feedback (REP-045): 10 rounds with 4 players took about 30 minutes. The new-game screen defaults to 10 days (Standard) in App.tsx; Quick is 8 days. The brief assumed 10 to 20 minutes. One game is one data point.
scope: Default the new-game length to Quick (8 days) when 3 or 4 shops are chosen, and show an expected time on the length buttons only after it has been timed
Make waiting skippable or faster where it can be (lorry, reveal, computer turns), without hiding information
Time a Quick 4-shop game on a real phone with a stopwatch before and after, and record it
Do not shorten the number of days or change rules in this plan; a shorter Quick is a rules change for a later plan
exclusions: Changing the number of days, supply or scoring

acceptance.text: Before timing recorded: Quick with 4 shops on a real phone with a stopwatch, both 1 human plus 3 computers and a 4-human online room (human waiting adds time)
Owner sets a target time before the change (proposed: 20 minutes or less for Quick with 4 shops)
After timing meets the target, or the owner accepts the result
verify and verify:full pass; no information hidden or rule changed
